end.summary:
Explored “unity in diversity” and “many in the one” through music and festivals.
Explained that different forms can have common values and bring people together.
Practised examples of regional festivals, food, language and dress.
Identified Phiran as Kashmiri dress and linked diversity with learning and friendship.
end.parentNote: Riya practised explaining how different languages, foods, dresses, music and festivals can share common values. They used examples such as Lohri, Pongal, Bihu, Makar Sankranti and Phiran, and connected diversity with making friends and learning from one another. They first described festivals as “basically same,” then clarified that the ways are different while the shared values include joy, gratitude and belonging. At home, ask Riya to make a four-column chart with one regional example each for language, food, dress and festival.
